sources.observations: DB constraint option can enforce non-overlap at commit/storage level; sample uses a time range, GiST, overlap operator, and optionally resource key + `btree_gist`. Constraint expresses only the encoded table rules; app must handle the conflict response, interval conventions, site/item identity, status/cancellation applicability, and retries.
